newsitem.title: USA: Grand Union says names Harris chairman.
newsitem.headline: Grand Union says names Harris chairman.

text.p: Grand Union Co said Monday it named J. Wayne Harris, the head of A&P Canada Ltd, as chairman, chief executive and a director of the 224-store grocery chain.

The appointment of Harris, 58, ends a three month search for a successor to Joseph McCaig, who resigned as president in early May after the company said he had differences with the board of directors over ways to achieve the chain's long-term objectives.
Grand Union emerged from bankruptcy court procedings in June, 1995.

"Wayne Harris is one of the finest grocery merchants in North America, a proven executive with strong leadership and performance skills." said Grand Union Chairman and acting Chief Executive Roger Strangeland. "The board has every confidence in Wayne's unique qualifications to lead Grand Union at this juncture in its 125-year history."
Stangeland will remain a director, chairman emeritus and consultant to the company.
A&P Canada is a unit of Great Atlantic & Pacific Tea Co Inc.
